bio_en: Ovsia Saghtejian, known to all as Tayi ('uncle') or Kara Tayi, was born in 1887 in Karadur in Kessab and respected by Armenians, Arabs, Turks and Alawites from Kessab to Antioch and Musa Dagh. In the stormy years of 1919-20 he founded, without outside help, a shelter for orphans, begging food and clothes for them and placing them in Armenian families. He was several times sentenced to life imprisonment or death by the authorities for his activities. Nikol Aghbalian is pictured with him in Kessab, and he died in January 1953.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
